Lakers @ Spurs 9/10 8:30 - 15-win teams, Fox and Harper questionable
Grizzlies @ Wolves 7/10 7:30 - Minnesota shorthanded, 14-5 teams meet
Heat @ Knicks 6/10 6:00 - Giannis visits a banged-up Knicks team

games.notes: Fox and Harper questionable for San Antonio; Lakers look healthy. Wemby against Luka and LeBron's group, the best game on the board and should be close.
Edwards and LaMelo Ball out for Minnesota; Edey and Stewart questionable for Memphis. Two 14-5 teams, but the Wolves are thin, so Memphis has a real shot.
Anunoby, Clarkson, McBride and Drummond out, Towns questionable for the champs; Giannis probable. Knicks depleted, so it should be close and worth the early slot.
Curry, Butler and Porzingis out for Golden State; Lillard and Sharpe out for Portland. Warriors without Curry is a skip unless you like the Blazers kids.
Embiid questionable (illness), Jaylen Brown out; Pacers without Haliburton. Best record in the league against a mid team, likely Philly unless Embiid sits.
McCollum out for Atlanta, Mitchell Robinson out for Boston. Good team against a mid one, likely a Celtics win.
Kyrie questionable, Lively out for Dallas; Mark Williams out for Phoenix. Two middling teams, only Dallas's young guys make it interesting.
Cade Cunningham and Duren out for Detroit, but Milwaukee is 2-17. Likely blowout.
Kawhi and RJ Barrett out for Toronto. Two bad teams, skip.
Jokic healthy; Jazz without Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. Likely blowout.
Murray out and Mathurin doubtful for New Orleans, Beal out for the Clippers. Two bad teams, skip.
